name: memstore
description: Team memory: search what the org's conversations, calls and documents say with their sources, follow the advice learned from past sessions, see where things stand, and remember what lasts.

interface.longDescription: Answers from what your team's Slack, calls, email and documents say, each claim citing the moment it comes from; where a customer, project or deal stands, with its gaps and open items; advice learned from how past sessions went; and notes you remember for the team. You only ever see what you may read.
interface.defaultPrompt: What did we decide about this, and where was it said?
